pages.title: One Interface, Many Containers
pages.text: The Advanced Interface keeps nine mixed caches and the same ownership rules, then extends ordinary Pull and Push across a configurable box. Select cache resources first, open the gear page, and include the target containers. The default 1x1x1 box excludes the interface itself.

pages.title: Shape the Region
pages.text: Set x/y/z size and +x/+y/+z offset, then enable preview to confirm the boundary. White marks interactable faces, green marks Pull, and red marks Push. The advanced two-colour overlay preserves the white base face beneath its behaviour colour.

pages.title: Schedule a Pass
pages.text: Period controls scan spacing. Access can skip unavailable targets or force a visit; distribution works per item or per stack; order runs near-first or far-first. Every position-face pair is a target, and a side with all faces disabled performs no work.

pages.title: Pull and Push
pages.text: Pull gathers interactable resources through the configured face of each regional container. Push offers the nine real caches according to each slot mask. Items, fluids, FE and loaded integration resources share the scheduler; directionless Sparks and Source capabilities retain their official behaviour.

pages.title: Return Before Changing
pages.text: Clearing, retargeting, or breaking first returns non-empty caches to the owner's Xianqiao. Only a remainder that cannot fit stays with the dropped block. The regional scheduler neither duplicates a resource nor hides a partial transfer inside a failed operation.
